record: Tarragona Museum of History amphitheatre description
facts: The elliptic arena measures 62.50 by 38.50 m with a 3.25 m podium and subterranean channels. Its northern structural seating reused the bedrock; vaults supported seating elsewhere.
The historical ellipse was approximately 109.5 by 86.5 m. The 6th-century Visigothic place of worship was overlain by the 12th-century church of Santa Maria del Miracle.
The lower and middle banks and a few rows of the upper seating survive. There were major openings on the long axis and a seaward platform for officials.
Original 5 m elevations cover the coastal hillside, excavation and surrounding terraces.
